channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Eleições 2026: pesquisas mostram dificuldade para terceira via decolar; veja histórico de outras disputas
item.description: Quaest poll shows 32% of voters identify as independent, but Lula (39%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (33%) dominate voting intentions, consuming 72% of electoral preference. Despite historical demand for a third way, candidates like Caiado (4%), Zema (4%) and Renan Santos (2%) fail to break polarization, repeating the pattern since 2014 when alternatives like Marina Silva and Ciro Gomes failed to reach the runoff.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei sobre transferência de assassinos de agentes
item.description: President Lula signed Law 15.407/2026, expanding the transfer of inmates convicted of qualified homicide against public security agents, military personnel, and judicial authorities to federal maximum-security prisons, amending the Penal Execution Law and allowing videoconference hearings. The law also modifies the differentiated disciplinary regime, permitting immediate inclusion upon request by prison authorities or the Public Prosecutor’s Office, with judicial rulings required within 15 days. The president vetoed four provisions, including automatic application of the DDR and waiver of formal recidivity requirements.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e seus argumentos que não ficam em pé
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator of the opposition, stated in a GloboNews interview that he had 'absolutely nothing to offer in exchange' for the money requested from Daniel Vorcaro, denying any implication of a quid pro quo. The comment was made during an interview with journalists Julia Duailibi, Malu Gaspar, and Octavio Guedes. The full article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: O novo projeto de Romulo Estrela após fim de ‘Três Graças’
item.description: Romulo Estrela, following the end of the telenovela Três Graças, is preparing to play an on-call doctor in the film Por um Fio, inspired by the work of Drauzio Varella. The 42-year-old actor underwent a significant physical transformation, losing over 10 kilos, and emphasized that the role breaks away from alpha male stereotypes. The project received symbolic support from President Lula, who viewed the film in a special screening and praised it on social media.

item.title: Defesa tímida de Flávio por aliados do PL incomoda campanha
item.description: Close allies of Flávio Bolsonaro in the PL party are dissatisfied with the timid defense following the leak of messages with banker Daniel Vorcaro, while more distant lawmakers, such as Sergio Moro, have spoken out more forcefully. The campaign views the incident as a political, not legal, crisis and demands stronger mobilization to prevent spillover effects on local candidacies.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas praised Jair Bolsonaro as a great president who changed his political outlook and defined Bolsonarism as a right-wing, patriotic, and conservative project. He said this legacy must be recovered and is now in the hands of Bolsonaro's son, Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Rodrigo Prando na Crusoé: A política como nuvem
item.description: President Lula is in a politically vulnerable position, facing negative evaluations in key areas such as public safety and the economy, compounded by the rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the Supreme Court. This highlights weaknesses in his political coordination, leaving him weakened, as if 'on the ropes'.

item.title: Flávio compara filme a samba para Lula e dispara: "Marretada neles"
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro compared the film Dark Horse, funded by Daniel Vorcaro and honoring his father Jair Bolsonaro, to the Acadêmicos de Niterói samba about Lula, criticizing the use of public funds in culture. He stated he did not receive Rouanet Law resources for the film and said he is 'more motivated than ever,' using the phrase 'marretada neles' against the PT government. The speech took place at the launch of Guilherme Derrite’s Senate pre-candidracy, before a bolsonarist crowd that responded with applause and chants of 'out with PT'.

item.title: Havengate: o fundo na mira da PF que conecta Vorcaro, Flávio e Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating the Texas-based Havengate fund, which received at least $2 million from a company linked to Vorcaro, connecting it to Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro. Both deny any wrongdoing, stating the transfers were conducted legally.

item.title: 59% reduziram compras internacionais após “taxa das blusinhas”
item.description: A CNDL survey reveals that 59% of Brazilians reduced or stopped buying from international websites between June 2024 and June 2025 due to the 'little shirts tax,' a 20% import duty on purchases under US$50 that took effect in August 2024. On May 12, 2026, President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a provisional measure eliminating the import tax on such purchases, though state-level ICMS still applies and the measure is valid for up to 120 days pending Congressional approval. The study also found an 18-percentage-point drop in domestic online shopping, from 89% to 70.9% over the same period.

item.title: Mesmo com “taxa das blusinhas”, 96% compraram em sites internacionais
item.description: Despite the 'little shirts tax' being in effect from August 2024 to May 2026, 96% of Brazilians made international online purchases between June 2024 and June 2025, though this represents a slight decline from 97.6% to 95.8%. President Lula signed a provisional measure on May 12, 2026, eliminating the 20% import tax on international purchases under US$50, already in force, as part of an electoral strategy for a fourth term. The CNDL survey also shows a significant drop in domestic online purchases (from 89% to 70.9%), with clothing being the top international purchase category at 40.8%.

item.title: E Flávio, como vai?
item.description: A survey by Blog do Noblat shows that 95.4% of 153 readers believe Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's situation worsens as he explains his ties to the owner of Banco Master. Only 4.6% think his situation improves, reflecting strong public rejection of his justifications.

item.title: Shopee e Mercado Livre são sites internacionais preferidos no Brasil
item.description: Lula signed a provisional measure eliminating the 20% 'blusinhas' tax on international purchases under US$50, aiming to boost consumption ahead of the October 2026 elections. A CNDL survey found 96% of Brazilians made international online purchases between June 2024 and June 2025, with Shopee (72.8%) and Mercado Livre (63%) as top platforms, despite a slight decline in international shoppers (from 97.6% to 95.8%). The measure, valid for up to 120 days, requires Congressional approval and does not affect ICMS, which varies by state.

item.title: Depois de mínima, risco Brasil volta a subir sob Lula
item.description: Brazil's risk indicator rose to 121 points on May 15, 2026, after reaching its lowest level of Lula's third term at 116 points on May 8, showing market sensitivity to domestic fiscal conditions, global financial markets, and electoral expectations. Despite recovery from the March 2023 peak of 280 points, the indicator remains above pre-pandemic levels and the Bolsonaro government's low of 93 points in February 2020.

item.title: Relação de Flávio Bolsonaro com Vorcaro faz senador quebrar recorde de pesquisas no Google
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro reached a record number of Google searches after asking banker Daniel Vorcaro for millions to fund a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. Interest in their relationship generated three times more searches than his presidential candidacy, according to Google Trends. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: Lula vai a SP lançar financiamento de R$ 30 bi para motoristas de apps
item.description: President Lula (PT) is set to announce a R$ 30 billion financing program for app-based drivers during an upcoming visit to São Paulo. The measure was discussed with Minister of the Presidency’s General Secretariat, Guilherme Boulos, aiming to support a sector facing regulatory and labor challenges. The announcement in a state governed by Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos-SP) reflects the PT’s political strategy to engage informal workers ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: ‘Vender as terras do Estado é um crime’
item.description: São Paulo's state law allowing the sale of vacant lands with discounts of up to 90% is criticized for turning land regularization into a public subsidy for land grabbers, according to former Justice Secretary Belisário dos Santos Jr. He argues the policy violates the social function of land, originally intended for agrarian reform and environmental preservation, and that placing the Itesp under the Agriculture Department undermines its original autonomous mission. The opposition estimates the subsidy could create a fiscal hole exceeding R$ 7.68 billion.

item.title: O nó das mentiras repetidas dia a dia por Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faced criticism for treating his candidacy as a bargaining tool to secure amnesty for his father, Jair Bolsonaro, conditioning his withdrawal from the race on political concessions. His credibility collapsed after revelations that he received funding from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to produce a film glorifying his father, fueling accusations of repeated lies and political desperation. Despite briefly tying with Lula in polls, his incoherent behavior and lack of charisma prevented him from gaining lasting support.

item.title: Anúncios pagos sobre o STF explodem nas redes sociais e colocam Corte no centro do debate eleitoral
item.description: Paid advertisements about the Supreme Federal Court (STF) on social media increased over 50 times between 2020 and 2026, reaching nearly 4,9 thousand records between January and April 2026, according to a survey by Estadão using Meta’s ad library. The rise is tied to the growing politicization of the Court, with politicians and pre-candidates — especially Senate hopefuls — using digital campaigns to criticize ministers such as Alexandre de Moraes, Dias Toffoli, and Gilmar Mendes, advocate for reducing the STF’s powers, or mobilize electoral bases. Campaigns include attacks on ministers’ conduct, controversies like alleged ties to Banco Master, and the rejection of Jorge Messias’s nomination, raising concerns about disinformation and potential challenges before the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Zema se descola da família Bolsonaro e enterra possibilidade de ser vice de Flávio
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) distanced himself from the Bolsonaro family after a leaked conversation between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro revealed Flávio requesting money to fund a film about Jair Bolsonaro. Zema condemned the act as 'imperdoável' and damaging to the credibility needed to change Brazil, ruling out a vice-presidential run on Flávio’s ticket. The move sparked internal conflict in Novo, with criticism from party branches in Paraná and Santa Catarina, and a rebuttal from Flávio, who called Zema premature and accused him of hindering efforts to defeat the PT.

item.title: Aos 92 anos, Vó da Havan tem carteira assinada e quebra recorde nacional
item.description: A 92-year-old employee known as 'Vó da Havan' was recognized by RankBrasil in 2026 as the oldest person in Brazil with a formal work contract, breaking a national record. Her case reignites the debate on active aging and the inclusion of seniors in the labor market, highlighting the potential for productive longevity amid population aging.

item.title: Financiamento e contrato confidencial: as lacunas nas versões apresentadas pelos filhos acerca do filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro have presented conflicting accounts regarding the financing of the film "Dark Horse," including claims of a contract with banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, later attributed to a separate entity, Entre Investimentos. The Federal Police are investigating whether funds sent to the Havengate Development Fund LP, linked to Eduardo Bolsonaro, were used solely for film production or also to support Eduardo Bolsonaro’s stay in the United States. The contradictions have raised suspicions of fund misappropriation and lack of transparency.

item.title: A gargalhada de Flávio eleva a mentira a um novo patamar de cinismo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was caught laughing scornfully when questioned by Intercept Brasil about corruption allegations, a display described as reaching a new level of political cynicism. The incident, framed as destined for political annals due to its mocking tone, drew criticism for trivializing serious accusations. The report is available exclusively to Intercept Brasil subscribers.

item.title: Furacão que varreu figuras da direita influenciará pesquisas
item.description: Federal Police operations in May targeted influential figures of the Brazilian right, including a Centrão senator investigated for ties to the largest banking fraud in history, a senator allied with a presidential candidate who had financial and personal links to the same former banker, and an inelegible former governor accused of favoring the country’s biggest tax evader. These developments may influence voter perception in October polls ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Após denúncia pela PGR, Zema diz que não recuará “1 milímetro”
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and 2026 presidential pre-candidate, responded to a PGR indictment for slander against Justice Gilmar Mendes by stating he would not back down 'by a millimeter'. The indictment stems from Zema’s AI-generated web series 'Os Intocáveis', which falsely attributes passive corruption crimes to Mendes. The PGR argues the content exceeds free speech and constitutes slander under Article 138 of the Brazilian Penal Code.

item.title: POR QUE LULA VOLTOU ATRÁS NA TAXA DAS BLUSINHAS?
item.description: President Lula reversed his proposal to tax international purchases under US$50 (known as 'blusinhas') after strong backlash from retailers, consumers, and political allies who argued it would disproportionately affect lower-income groups. The retreat reflects a strategic move to avoid political damage in a sensitive election year, while maintaining focus on other revenue sources.

item.title: 'Ele merece ou não este filme?', diz Flávio Bolsonaro ao defender uso de verba para obra sobre o pai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) defended the use of public funds to finance a film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro, during an event in Campinas. His defense followed revelations by The Intercept Brasil that he had pressured banker Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master to provide funding for the production. Bolsonaro argued the film deserves to be made, regardless of controversy.

item.title: Derrite defende Senado conservador e evita caso Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) launched his pre-campaign for the Federal Senate in Campinas (SP), advocating for a conservative majority in Congress to influence its direction and elect a right-wing president. The event included allies such as Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), Tarcísio de Freitas, and Sérgio Moro, but avoided discussing the Vorcaro and Banco Master case, focusing instead on the right’s 2026 strategy and labeling the PCC as a terrorist organization.

item.title: Dirceu manterá pré-candidatura à Câmara mesmo com câncer, diz filho
item.description: Former Minister José Dirceu (PT), 80, diagnosed with duodenal lymphoma, confirmed he will maintain his pre-candidacy for the Chamber of Deputies from São Paulo despite undergoing chemotherapy. His son, Zeca Dirceu, stated in an Instagram post that his father 'does not bend' and remains determined in his political mission, citing past triumphs over dictatorship, elections, kidney cancer in 2020, head surgery in 2024, and unjust imprisonments.

item.title: Tarcísio: Avançamos em São Paulo sem ter apoio do governo federal
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that the state progressed despite lacking federal government support and used the speech to advocate for the revival of former President Jair Bolsonaro's political project.

item.title: “O Bolsonaro merece ou não merece um filme?”, pergunta Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) used the launch of Guilherme Derrite’s (PP-SP) Senate pre-candidacy in Campinas to deny allegations linking him to businessman Daniel Vorcaro and reaffirm his intention to run for president in 2026.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro pede ao STF apuração sobre vazamento de conversas com Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign coordinator, Senator Rogério Marinho, urged Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça to investigate the selective leak of conversations between Flávio and Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro, revealed by Intercept Brasil, which showed negotiations for private funding of a film about Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio admitted requesting the funds but denied wrongdoing, stating no public money or Rouanet Law was involved. The STF confirmed it will investigate the leak, while the Federal Police had previously authenticated the audio from Vorcaro’s seized phone.

item.title: ‘Não abaixem a cabeça’, pede Flávio Bolsonaro aos aliados após crise sobre áudio com Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) urged his allies not to bow their heads following controversy over audio recordings in which he requested money from banker Daniel Vorcaro for the film 'Dark Horse', about his father. He declared himself more motivated than ever, citing a biblical verse and asserting that the Bolsonaro banner will never be red. Governor Tarcísio de Freitas called him a 'future president of the Republic', avoided directly addressing the episode, and the press conference was canceled due to his delay.

item.title: Mendonça prevalece e STF rejeita ação sobre monitoramento de jornalistas e deputados
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court rejected, by a vote of 7 to 4, an action challenging the monitoring of lawmakers and journalists by the Bolsonaro government, stating that no proof was presented of harm to freedom of expression or characterization as 'espionage'. The dissenting vote by Minister André Mendonça was upheld by six other justices, while rapporteur Cármen Lúcia and three colleagues maintained opposition. The 2020 lawsuit filed by the Green Party alleged improper use of public funds and abuse of purpose in reports classifying posts by ideological alignment.

item.title: Caiado diz que não fará 'juízo de valor' sobre comportamento de Flávio Bolsonaro e critica governo Lula
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), a pre-candidate for president, said he will not make a 'value judgment' on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) behavior regarding the alleged request for funding from Banco Master to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro, stating that each person is responsible for their own actions. Despite his cautious tone toward the rival, Caiado harshly criticized the Lula government, calling it 'populist' and 'irresponsible', and cited indebtedness, improvised measures, and pressure on governors.

item.title: A consequência para Zema após os vídeos contra Gilmar Mendes
item.description: The Attorney General's Office denounced former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema to the Superior Court of Justice for slander against Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes, following social media videos titled 'The Untouchables' that falsely linked Mendes to the Banco Master case. Zema, a pre-candidate for president in 2026, had the denunciation filed on Friday (15) and declared he would not back down. Mendes had previously included Zema in the Fake News inquiry and criticized his administration in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que ‘Daniel Vorcaro era um astro no Brasil’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential pre-candidate, admitted requesting money from Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, to finance the film 'Dark Horse' about Jair Bolsonaro's life. He justified the request by stating that, at the time of contact, Vorcaro was a 'star in Brazil', well-connected with authorities and without known issues, although the conversations occurred after investigations into the bank's fraud had become public. Flávio denied wrongdoing, calling the funds legitimate sponsorship, and acknowledged receiving up to US$10 million by 2025, while negotiations had reached US$24 million.

item.title: Joaquim Barbosa vai disputar a Presidência?
item.description: Former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa signed a membership form with the Christian Democracy (DC) party in early April, signaling a potential presidential pre-candidacy for 2026. The party had initially backed former minister Aldo Rebelo but shifted strategy after his pre-candidacy failed to gain traction in polls.

item.title: Plano de investimento de filme sobre Bolsonaro previa cotas de 1 milhão de dólares e 'oportunidade de imigração'
item.description: The investment plan for the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, offered shares ranging from $500,000 to $1.1 million, including an unusual promise of a 'U.S. immigration opportunity' for the highest-tier investors. Eduardo Bolsonaro served as executive producer, assisting in fundraising, while the total budget reached $45 million. The project involved negotiations with Flávio Bolsonaro and jailed banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Flávio é chamado de “ladrão” em visita a quartel da PM no Rio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was heckled and called a 'thief' by protesters during a ceremony at the Rio de Janeiro Military Police Headquarters, following leaked audio linking him to businessman Daniel Vorcaro, involved in the Master scandal. Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino authorized a preliminary investigation into alleged misuse of parliamentary amendments to fund the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro. Flávio denies wrongdoing, stating the funds were private investments with expected financial return.

item.title: Eleições 2026: testes confirmam, mais uma vez, a segurança do sistema eleitoral brasileiro
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) concluded the second phase of the 2025 Public Urn Test, confirming the security of Brazil's electronic voting system. No findings compromised vote secrecy or integrity, reinforcing the robustness of the electoral process. Improvements suggested by investigators in the December phase were implemented by technical teams, further strengthening the system.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro queima (o filme) na largada
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro admitted requesting R$134 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro for the production of the film 'Dark Horse', but provided no contract nor identified the final recipient of the funds, and was contradicted by the film's director, Mário Frias. He later acknowledged the money went to a fund managed by his lawyer Paulo Calixto, who is linked to his brother Eduardo, raising suspicions of diversion and conflict of interest. The case raises allegations of passive corruption under Article 317 of the Brazilian Penal Code, with potentially devastating consequences for his 2026 candidacy.

item.title: URGENTE! É um MILAGRE de DEUS! BOLSONARO SOLTO da PRISÃO LULA e XANDAO em PÂNICO nas ELEIÇÕES 2026!
item.description: The shared content is a sensationalist and misleading video falsely claiming Jair Bolsonaro’s release from prison and the panic of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Alexandre de Moraes ahead of the 2026 elections. There is no legal or factual basis for these claims, as Bolsonaro is not incarcerated and is currently facing legal proceedings while free. The video uses emotional language, apocalyptic tone, and disinformation tactics to engage viewers, without providing verifiable evidence or context.

item.title: PGR denuncia Zema ao STJ por calúnia a Gilmar Mendes em post sobre relação de ministros com o Master
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) has filed a complaint against former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema at the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) for slander against Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes. The accusation stems from an ironic social media post suggesting Mendes had favored Justice Dias Toffoli in exchange for personal benefits at the Tayayá resort, linking it to the Master case. The PGR seeks R$ 162,000 in moral damages, arguing the post went beyond legitimate criticism and falsely attributed public administration crimes to Mendes.

item.title: Zema é denunciado por calúnia contra Gilmar Mendes
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and presidential pré-candidate for the Novo party, has been denounced for the crime of slander in a criminal action before the Superior Tribunal of Justice. The complaint, filed by Prosecutor-General Paulo Gonet, concerns the production and dissemination of AI-generated videos attacking Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes.

item.title: PGR denuncia Zema sob acusação de calúnia contra Gilmar Mendes
item.description: The Attorney General's Office filed a criminal complaint against former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema, a pre-candidate for president in 2026, on charges of slander against Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes, stemming from a series of videos Zema released that allegedly defamed the magistrate. The indictment comes amid the intensifying 2026 presidential race, with Zema positioned as a leading figure in Brazil's liberal-conservative camp.

item.title: Eduardo se junta a Flávio na lista de contradições do clã Bolsonaro sobre o dinheiro de Vorcaro
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro admitted signing an executive producer contract for the film Dark Horse, receiving and returning $50,000 from Daniel Vorcaro, after initially claiming he only licensed his image. He joins Flávio Bolsonaro and Mário Frias in a pattern of contradictions regarding the film’s financing, which reportedly received 61 million reais from Vorcaro for U.S.-based production. The case exposes inconsistencies in the Bolsonaro clan’s narratives about Vorcaro-linked funds, undermining Flávio’s presidential pre-candidacy.

item.title: Taffarel revela conversa com Bento após falha e aposta em recuperação de Alisson até a Copa
item.description: Brazil's goalkeeping coach Cláudio Taffarel revealed he spoke with Bento after a mistake in the Saudi League, downplaying the error and emphasizing that players should be evaluated in broader context. He also confirmed that Alisson, the team's starting goalkeeper, is in advanced recovery from a right thigh injury and is expected to return to play next week, with hopes of being fit for the 2026 World Cup. Taffarel praised both goalkeepers, calling Alisson one of the best in the world and noting strong similarities to his own playing style.

item.title: Augusto Cury comenta relação entre os irmãos Bolsonaro e Vorcaro: 'Eles têm que explicar isso à Justiça'
item.description: Augusto Cury, psychiatrist and presidential pre-candidate for the Avante party, stated that the Bolsonaro family must explain to the Justice system why they requested money from banker Daniel Vorcaro, under investigation for billion-dollar frauds, to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro. He called the case an 'unprecedented crime' and suggested it may be part of a larger corruption scheme, advocating for harsher penalties and preventive measures.

item.title: PGR denuncia Romeu Zema por calúnia contra Gilmar Mendes e pede indenização
item.description: The Prosecutor General's Office filed a criminal complaint against former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema for slandering Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes by falsely accusing him of passive corruption on social media. The MPF seeks a minimum civil compensation of 100 minimum wages for moral damages, citing the post's reach of 487,200 views on X and 2.8 million on Instagram. Zema responded that he will not 'back down an inch,' framing the criticism as resistance to untouchable elites.
